outcome: Give head of e-commerce / merchandising director a governed method to improve sales per square metre using store demographics, basket data and planograms, with final decisions retained by named staff.
overview: Retail Space and Assortment Localisation addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in retail and e-commerce operations. The first proof of value uses store demographics, basket data and planograms. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is sales per square metre, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

benefits.text: Measurable improvement in sales per square metre
benefits.limits: Basis: customer-specific hypothesis. No uplift promised; validate in controlled pilot

benefits.limits: Basis: design property. Applies only to events routed through the new workflow

notFor.situation: Organisations without authorized access to store demographics, basket data and planograms
notFor.why: there is no defensible evidence base.

notFor.situation: Projects seeking fully autonomous safety, credit, clinical, enforcement or irreversible actions. Merchandising signs assortment changes.
notFor.why: Stated in the catalogue record as outside the intended fit.

notFor.situation: Sites without a named owner for customer trust, pricing and promotions and an exception management process.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: store demographics, basket data and planograms; define sales per square metre and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of E-commerce / Merchandising Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for sales per square metre
